# Filippo Negroni

> Filippo Negroni builds AI solutions for adults with ADHD. Each solution fits the tools the person already uses. He works by video call with English speakers in any country and any time zone. Clients can start in two ways. They can build the solution with him on a video call for £50 an hour, which is his founding client rate for hours booked by 31 December 2026. They pay first, and the hour includes a short written recap and seven days of email questions. Or they can describe the problem for free and get a fixed quote with two options, and he builds the one they choose. The quote page shows an estimate of the hourly price in other currencies.

Every page on this site is plain HTML and needs no JavaScript to read.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://fenegroni.com/): The home page introduces the offer and shows example solutions.
- [Solutions](https://fenegroni.com/work.html): This page lists the Claude Skills, MCP servers and coded tools Filippo has built.
- [How it works](https://fenegroni.com/quote.html): This page explains the two ways to start and their prices, holds the quote form and lists what clients should know before they pay.
- [Media](https://fenegroni.com/media.html): This page collects articles and media about what Filippo learns while putting AI to work.

## Examples

- [When I get stuck](https://fenegroni.com/example-adhd-assist.html): My own advice comes back to me at the moment I get stuck and cannot reach it.
- [When habits slip off the calendar](https://fenegroni.com/example-pillars.html): Sleep, medication and meals keep their place on the calendar in a busy week.
- [When my attention drifts or I am tired](https://fenegroni.com/example-webcam-monitor.html): A quiet alert tells me when my attention drifts or I am tired.
- [When slides swallow the story](https://fenegroni.com/example-presentation.html): The story of a talk comes first, and the slides follow.
- [When recording breaks the flow](https://fenegroni.com/example-midi-sequencer.html): I keep playing the keyboard, and the AI handles the recording.
